integrity: Proof uses algebraic run-product comparison and explicit six-run witness for the infinite regime, with an exhaustive check only for the five base lengths 4..8. Closest prior n=6 failure is acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact five-run capacity and its equality set with unrestricted maximum for all n>=4; does not give unrestricted maxima for all n or prove six-run hosts are always unrestricted maximizers.
title: Sharp five-run capacity and exceptional optimizers for the binary subsequence \(0101\)
